creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The focus-only verbs that turn a refusal into prose (`step`, `focus_tab`, `focus_pane_at` in the seam's handler) still say "the daemon did not make that change" when herdr timed out. Since `5a5abb4` the other intents say it may have happened.

The keyboard move is Muster's own and has already happened, so the wrong sentence costs little. Minor.
title: Focus-only verbs still say nothing moved on a timeout
